versions.content: Description of Data Exchange Point Shall Describe Relevant or Excluded Subset of the AUTOSAR Meta-Model Type: valid Description: The standardization template shall support description of the subset of the meta-model that is relevant for the data exchange point. Rationale: Document which parts of the meta-model are involved at a specific step in the methodology. Helps to ovoid interoperability issues: • Application of strict XML schema without tailoring • Missing elements/attributes • Structures without content and orphans - undefined behavior • Loss of information • Missing implementation of AUTOSAR feature or modeling pattern • Configuration in ECU Configuration instead of upstream templates, • Multiple possibilities for expressing the same thing Use Case: [UC_STDT_00020] Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
